'''Maron''' (Japanese: '''マサ''' ''Masa'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. He is the [[battle judge]] of the {{Gdis|Battle Tower|III}}.

He first appeared in ''[[AG169|Talking a Good Game!]]'' where {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived in the Battle Tower. After Ash told him that he wished to challenged the [[Frontier Brain]], Maron took the group inside and introduced them to the Frontier Brain, who was none other than [[Anabel]]. The {{pkmn|battle}} between Ash and Anabel began and Maron refereed the battle. After Ash lost, Maron declared Anabel the winner.

He reappeared in ''[[AG170|Second Time's the Charm!]]'', where he refereed the rematch between Ash and Anabel, with Ash as the victor this time.
